title: CAST Agent Status Block
description: Schema for the structured Status block that every CAST agent must include in its final response. Currently enforced via prompt instructions; this schema enables future machine verification via Structured Outputs.

status.description: Terminal status of the agent's task execution.

summary.description: One-line summary of what was accomplished or why the agent is blocked.

concerns.description: List of concerns when status is DONE_WITH_CONCERNS. Required when status is DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.

context_needed.description: Description of missing context when status is NEEDS_CONTEXT. Required when status is NEEDS_CONTEXT.

blocker.description: Description of the blocking issue when status is BLOCKED. Required when status is BLOCKED.

files_changed.description: List of absolute file paths that were created or modified.

worktree_branch.description: Git branch name when the agent ran in worktree isolation mode.
